overrides.value:
Animate the black armored wolf mount with red armor spikes and its dark-haired olive-clothed rider from the single reference image as a seamless repeating running-in-place game animation.

Keep the exact original REAR FOLLOW camera throughout. We see the rider and mount FROM BEHIND, facing directly away. Feet cycle away from the viewer while the whole character stays in place. Never reveal a front face, side profile or orbit the camera.

The four-legged wolf gallops rhythmically IN PLACE. Alternate gathered legs beneath the body with compact reaching strides and clearly separated paw push-off phases. Keep the tail and all armor pieces attached. The rider remains seated and holds the reins with subtle elbow motion.

Sustain a steady complete repeated motion from the start through the end, with matching stride phase at the loop boundary. Keep the head and torso proportions constant. The mount's original body and rider must stay recognizable in every frame. Do not merely slide or shake a static picture.

Anchor the entire character group at the exact original horizontal center and ground level. Preserve the original character size relative to the square canvas and all empty margins. Use only small natural gait motion; do not enlarge, recenter, shrink or crop the subject. Keep every ear, foot, tail, saddle, rider, hair and accessory within the frame. Fixed camera: no zoom, pan, tracking, orbit, cuts, shake or reframing. Preserve the exact rider identity, costume, face, hairstyle, colors, mount anatomy, equipment and illustrated 2D rendering style.

Keep a perfectly flat uniform solid magenta background, #FF00FF, for every frame. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, added characters, new equipment, motion blur, dust, smoke, trails, flashes or new magic effects. Preserve only effects that already belong to the reference. No speech or music.
